name: weixin-cloud-bridge
description: Self-hosted single-owner Weixin bridge for ChatGPT dots using OAuth and MCP Events. Experimental; not directory-approved.

interface.shortDescription: Self-hosted Weixin receive and reply tools
interface.longDescription: Connect your own Weixin ClawBot to a ChatGPT dot through Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects. OAuth authentication, event-triggered text processing, and replies to the original conversation. Experimental single-owner deployment.
